raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Since the 2026-01-15 rollout, the v2 collector sends txn_ts in UTC while legacy sends America/Chicago local time. The pipeline treats both as the same time, so v2 rows land 6 hours late: evening local transactions show up as 00:00-06:00 and spill into the wrong txn_date, including a spurious 2026-01-19. The fix converts v2 timestamps to Chicago local time (UTC-6 in January; no DST change in the data range) to match legacy and history.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.85, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, CAST(CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) - INTERVAL 6 HOUR ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
